title: Claude says it's Qwen. Here's why.
description:
Ask Claude what model it is, in Chinese, and it says it's Qwen, a Chinese model. DeepSeek calls itself ChatGPT in 5 of 8 tries. Grok once refused a task citing OpenAI's policy. They all trained on each other's text from the open web, so none of them can reliably tell you what they even are. A model's name isn't an ID card, it's an echo of its training data. If it's this confident and this wrong about its own name, what else is it confidently wrong about?

Sources: the Claude-in-Chinese test (May 2026), TechCrunch's DeepSeek test (Dec 2024), and the photocopy-of-a-photocopy line from Mike Cook (King's College London).
